responses: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.
Past medical history: Newborn, no past medical history available. Social history: Mother is a primigravida, no prenatal care received.
No additional symptoms noted by the mother. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Cellulitis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.
